metadata.Name: MultiWOZ-X
metadata.Description: MultiWOZ-X is a large-scale multilingual dataset for multi-domain and multi-task task-oriented dialogues (TOD). It is a professionally translated and manually curated corpus of 2,000 dialogues from the original MultiWOZ, spanning Arabic, Chinese, German, and Russian across 7 domains. It is designed for evaluating models on tasks like dialogue state tracking (DST) and response retrieval (RR).
metadata.Paper Title: MultiWOZ-X: A Multilingual, Multi-Domain, and Multi-Task Benchmark for Task-Oriented Dialogues
metadata.Venue Title: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2022
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: Research in task-oriented dialogue (TOD) systems has been recently advanced by the availability of large-scale datasets such as MultiWOZ. However, such datasets are monolingual (English-only), which limits the development of multilingual TOD systems. In this work, we introduce MultiWOZ-X, a new large-scale multilingual dataset for multi-domain and multi-task TOD. It is a professionally translated and manually curated corpus of 2,000 dialogues from the original MultiWOZ, spanning 4 languages (Arabic, Chinese, German, and Russian) and 7 domains. We provide a comprehensive empirical study of state-of-the-art multilingual models on two key TOD tasks, dialogue state tracking (DST) and response retrieval (RR), in both zero-shot and few-shot cross-lingual transfer setups. Our results indicate that 1) conversational pre-training on target languages substantially improves the sample efficiency in few-shot transfer, and 2) the performance of cross-lingual transfer for TOD is heavily dependent on the linguistic proximity between the source and target languages. We hope that MultiWOZ-X will foster future research in multilingual TOD.
